analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading sessions. RSI has cooled from overbought territory into the neutral zone, but the MACD histogram continues to worsen, falling to the 0.2071 level. Volume ratio at 0.46 confirms subdued buying interest. The current price of $98.16 is below the swing resistance of $99.64, and while above the SMA20 ($95.14), it is below the SMA5 ($99.31). This is a phase where a trend reversal cannot be confidently confirmed.
